1.label: Clean & Dry
1.description: Lower pollutant load with dry-air conditions.

0.label: Average / Baseline
0.description: Most variables remain close to the dataset baseline.

3.label: Extreme Low Pressure
3.description: Pressure is strongly below the standard training baseline while pollutants are not necessarily high.

2.label: Severe Pollution / Stagnant
2.description: Pollutant load, ozone, or humidity indicates a high-risk accumulation mode.

driver_view.note: Driver View ranks the current raw pollutant inputs by sub-AQI contribution, while supervised and unsupervised model inputs are standardized internally.

deployment_note: Runtime unsupervised outputs are generated by trained K-Means and Isolation Forest joblib artifacts, using the same scaler and feature order as the deployed supervised models.
